svg.text: The 256 elementary cellular automata, grouped by behaviour

Each rule from a single black cell (top) and from the same random row (bottom), a 81-cell window of a 211-cell ring. Bold numbers are the smallest rule in each mirror/complement class; the other 168 rules are their reflections and negatives.
Uniform · 24 rules · every random start ends all black or all white
Periodic · 196 rules · every random start falls into an exact cycle within 4000 steps
Complex · 6 rules · no cycle in 4000 steps, but the tail compresses well beyond its density
Chaotic · 30 rules · no cycle in 4000 steps, and the tail compresses no better than a biased coin
